evals.name: basic-invocation
evals.prompt: Grill me on our caching strategy and capture the decisions in a CONTEXT.md.
evals.expected_output: One-question-at-a-time interrogation plus a CONTEXT.md or ADR-style document that records each resolved decision as it lands.
assertions: The output produces or updates a persistent decision document
The document records decisions with rationale
Questioning continues until branches are resolved

evals.name: ambiguous-input
evals.prompt: Let's do the grill-with-docs thing on the new project.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks which project/plan and where the document should live before starting.
assertions: The output clarifies the subject and document location
The output does not fabricate project context
The output explains what will be persisted

evals.name: complex-scenario
evals.prompt: Grill me on a pricing-model change that touches billing, grandfathering, and sales comp, and keep an ADR updated as we resolve each area.
evals.expected_output: Sequential interrogation across the three domains with an ADR that accumulates dated, scoped decisions.
assertions: The ADR separates decisions by domain
Cross-domain conflicts are surfaced during questioning
The document stays consistent as decisions accumulate
